test_set_dtype_context_manager: test the set_dtype context manager to temporarily change the default tensor dtype within a scoped block
test_get_current_dtype: test the get_current_dtype function to retrieve the current thread-local floating-point data type
test_nested_set_dtype_scopes: test nested set_dtype context managers to verify dtype scoping and restoration after exiting each scope
test_datatype_context_abstraction: test the DataTypeContext abstract class interface for getting and setting the current floating-point data type
test_default_dtype_fallback: test that tensors created outside any set_dtype scope default to torch.float32 as the standard dtype
